relationships.evidence_quote: Spontaneous remyelination was observed in the vehicle-treated group, however, LY2940094 treatment accelerated this process (Fig. 4B and C).

key_findings: NOPR antagonist LY2940094 promotes OPC differentiation, in vitro myelination and remyelination in cuprizone mice independent of NOPR.
LY2940094 upregulates Myrf and downregulates ID4 without altering ERK1/2, AKT or GSK3beta phosphorylation.
